acceleratedrendering.configuration.secti.zh: 加速渲染客户端配置项

acceleratedrendering.configuration.secti.en: Configurations of features provided by Accelerated Rendering
acceleratedrendering.configuration.secti.zh: 用于配置由加速渲染提供的优化特性的配置项目录

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Core Settings
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 核心配置

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Core Settings allows you to change setting that are related to all rendering features.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 核心配置包含了能影响所有渲染特性的配置

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Sparse Mesh Uploading Threshold
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 稀疏模型上传阈值

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
Maximum amount of same meshes in a draw before it is switched to dense uploading method.
Changing this value may affects your FPS in certain situation. Smaller value means meshes will use dense mesh uploading with fewer occurrences, while larger values means meshes will use sparse mesh uploading even with higher occurrences.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
单次绘制中一个模型在被切换到密集模型上传模式前的最大出现次数.
修改此项数值可能会在特定情况下影响FPS, 越低的值代表当模型出现次数更低时模型仍然会被切换到密集模型上传模式, 反之亦然.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Maximum Pooled Ring Buffer Size
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 环形缓存池最大数量

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less in-flight frames, while larger values means more in-flight frames. More in-flight frames means more FPS but more VRAM.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 修改此项数值可能会影响FPS, 越高的值代表允许越多"in-flight frames", 反之亦然. 允许的"in-flight frames"越多, 提升的FPS越多, 但占用的显存也越多.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Maximum Pooled Batching Size
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 单次绘制最大允许合批数量

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less batches allowed in a draw call, while larger values means more batches. More batches means more FPS but more VRAM and more CPU pressure on handling RenderTypes.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 修改此项数值可能会影响FPS, 越高的值代表允许越多RenderType合并在一次绘制中, 反之亦然, 允许的数量越多, 提升的FPS越多, 但是占用的显存越多, 并且消耗更多CPU资源处理合批.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Maximum Cached Image Size
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 缓存贴图最大数量

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less images allowed to be cached, while larger means more cached images. More cached images means more FPS but more RAM pressure.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 修改此项数值可能会影响FPS, 越高的值代表允许越多缓存贴图, 反之亦然, 允许的数量越多, 提升的FPS越多, 但是占用的内存越多.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Dynamic Render Type Cache UV Resolution
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 动态RenderType缓存UV分辨率

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Changing this value may affects your visual effects and VRAM usage. Smaller value means lower resolution in UV scrolling and less cached render types, while larger means higher resolution and more cached render types. Higher resolution means smoother animations on charged creepers and breezes but more VRAM usage.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 修改此项数值可能会影响和显存占用. 越小的值代表越低的UV滚动分辨率和越少的被缓存的RenderType, 反之亦然. 分辨率越高, 闪电苦力怕和旋风人的动画越流畅, 但是占用的显存越多.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Draw Method Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 绘制方法类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- INDIRECT: Indices of vertices will be generated automatically every draw call, which allows advanced orientation culling to be applied before the actual draw call. But it could be slightly slower when there are too many draw calls present in a frame.
- BASEVERTEX: Indices of vertices will be cached across the draw calls and frames, which will be faster when there are too many draw calls present in a frame. But orientation culling will be disabled when using this method.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- INDIRECT: 顶点的索引将会在每次绘制调用前自动生成, 因此可以在绘制前使用更高级的面朝向剔除. 但它可能会在每帧有过多绘制调用时有轻微的性能下降.
- BASEVERTEX: 顶点的索引将在绘制调用与帧之间复用缓存, 在每帧有过多绘制调用时能保证良好的性能. 但使用此方法会自动禁用面朝向剔除.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Mesh Builder Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 模型构造器类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- SIMPLE: All faces including invisible faces of the model will be included in the final mesh of the model. It might be slower when rendering some models but it allows same models with different textures to be merged more effectively.
- CULLED: Invisible faces of the model will be excluded from the final mesh of the model. It will speed up the rendering of some specific models but it might break the merging of same models with different textures.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- SIMPLE: 包括不可见面在内的所有面都将被纳入最终生成的模型中. 部分特殊模型可能会因此渲染速度较慢, 但这个方法能保证不同贴图的相同模型能更有效地被合并.
- CULLED: 不可见面将被剔除出最终生成的模型. 部分特殊模型的渲染速度会因此加快, 但拥有不同材质的相同模型可能会因此无法合并.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Enable Debug Context
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 启用调试上下文

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- DISABLED: Debug context will be disabled, which may cause significant rendering glitches on some NVIDIA cards because of the "theaded optimization".
- ENABLED: Debug context will be enabled, which can prevent NVIDIA driver from applying the "threaded optimization" that causes the glitches.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- DISABLED: 调试上下文将会被禁用, 可能会在部分启用"theaded optimization"的NVIDIA显卡上有严重视觉错误.
- ENABLED: 调试上下文将会被启用, 以阻止会NVIDIA显卡驱动应用会导致严重视觉错误的"threaded optimization".

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Enable Force Translucent Acceleration
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 启用强制加速半透明

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- DISABLED: Translucent RenderType will fallback to vanilla rendering pipeline if the accelerated pipeline does not support translucent sorting unless mods explicitly enable force translucent acceleration temporarily when rendering their own faces.
- ENABLED: Translucent RenderType will still be rendered in accelerated pipeline even if the pipeline does not support translucent sorting unless mods explicitly disable force translucent acceleration temporarily when rendering their own faces.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其面片时显示声明加速半透明, 否则被标记为半透明的RenderType将会在加速管线不支持半透明排序时使用原版渲染管线.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其面片时显式声明关闭强制半透明加速, 否则即使加速管线不支持半透明排序, 被标记为半透明的RenderType依然会使用加速管线进行渲染.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Mesh Instance Info Cache Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 模型实例缓存类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- SIMPLE: The most basic implementation of cache. Usually used for testing if other cache types are working correctly.
- HANDLE: Faster implementation of cache using VarHandle and flatten values to improve performance on read/write operations.
- UNSAFE: Fastest implementation of cache using unsafe memory operations that skip multiple safety checks to read/write.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- SIMPLE: 最基础的缓存实现, 通常用来检测其他缓存类型是否正常工作.
- HANDLE: 更快的缓存实现, 使用VarHandle和扁平化数据来提高读写性能.
- UNSAFE: 最快的缓存实现, 使用了不安全的内存操作来跳过多项检查进行读写.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Batching Layer Storage Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 合批层储存类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- SORTED: The basic implementation of batching layer storage that renders opaque and translucent geometries together in a single stage with better performance but slight visual glitches on translucent geometries.
- SEPARATED: The visually-precise implementation of batching layer storage that separates opaque and translucent geometries into two rendering stages to prevent visual glitches, slightly slower than basic implementation.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- SORTED: 最基础的实现, 将不透明与半透明模型一同在一个单独的阶段中进行渲染, 性能更好但可能造成半透明模型的视觉错误.
- SEPARATED: 视觉上更精确的实现, 将不透明与半透明模型分至两个单独的阶段渲染以防止视觉错误, 略慢于基础实现.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Mesh Merge Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 模型合并类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- IGNORED: Meshes with identical vertices will not be merged, which will use less RAM but more VRAM in storing duplicated meshes.
- MERGED: Meshes with identical vertices will be merged together, which will use less VRAM more RAM in storing the data of meshes used in merging.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- IGNORED: 拥有完全一致顶点的模型将不会被合并, 占用的内存更少但是为储存重复模型占用的显存更多.
- MERGED: 拥有完全一致顶点的模型将会被合并, 占用的显存更少但为储存合并所需要的信息所占用的内存更多.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Enable Uploading Mesh Immediately
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 启用立即上传模型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- DISABLED: Meshes that is going to be accelerated will be collected and uploaded together at the end for choosing better uploading method and increasing memory access efficiency to reach the best performance. Also this method allows mesh cache with bigger capacity (up to VRAM limit), but it may not follow the correct draw order.
- ENABLED: Meshes that is going to be accelerated will be uploaded immediately after the draw command. It is less efficient and only have about 2GB mesh cache (generally enough) but will follow the original draw order to get the most compatibility.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- DISABLED: 将要被加速的模型将会被统计收集并在最后统一上传以选择更好的上传方法和更好的内存访问效率, 同时这个方法允许更多(2GB以上直到显存限制)的模型缓存容量, 但这个方式可能不会按照正常渲染顺序并造成部分渲染异常.
- ENABLED: 将要被加速的模型将会在绘制指令后立即上传, 这样相对更低效, 且只有通常2GB左右的模型缓存(大多数情况下足够了), 但是能保证绘制顺序一致以提供最好的兼容性.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Enable Cache Dynamic Render Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 启用缓存动态RenderType

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- DISABLED: Dynamic render types like lightning on charged creepers and winds on breezes will not be accelerated for less VRAM usage and smoother animations, but may exceptionally skip acceleration in modded geometries using these render types.
- ENABLED: Dynamic render types like lightning on charged creepers and winds on breezes will be accelerated to accelerate modded geometries using these render types, but may have more VRAM usage and less smooth animations based on resolution settings.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- DISABLED: 诸如闪电苦力怕的闪电和旋风人的风所使用的动态RenderType将不会被加速, 占用更少显存的同时动画更流畅, 但可能意外跳过其他MOD使用这些动态RenderType进行渲染的模型的加速.
- ENABLED: 诸如闪电苦力怕的闪电和旋风人的风所使用的动态RenderType将会被加速以加速其他MOD使用这些动态RenderType进行渲染的模型, 但是占用更多显存, 以及基于分辨率设置可能导致的不太流畅的动画.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Viewport Restoring Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 可视区域还原类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- IGNORED: Viewport settings that will be modified by other mods will not be restored after the acceleration, which is faster but reduces compatibility with them.
- MOJANG: Viewport settings that will be modified by other mods will be recorded and restored using Mojang's GLStateManager to work correctly with them.
- OPENGL: Viewport settings that will be modified by other mods will be recorded and restored using OpenGL to work correctly with them even if they don't set viewport using Mojang's GLStateManager, which is slower but has most compatibility.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- IGNORED: 禁用可视区域还原, 更快, 但可能降低了对修改了可视区域的MOD兼容性.
- MOJANG: 使用Mojang提供的GLStateManager对可能被其他MOD修改的可视区域进行记录和还原, 以改善兼容性.
- OPENGL: 使用OpenGL对可能被其他MOD修改的可视区域进行记录和还原, 以在即使MOD不使用Mojang提供的GLStateManager的情况下改善兼容性, 略慢但能保证最佳兼容性.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Scissor Restoring Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 裁切区域还原类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- IGNORED: Scissor settings that will be modified by other mods will not be restored after the acceleration, which is faster but reduces compatibility with them.
- MOJANG: Scissor settings that will be modified by other mods will be recorded and restored using Mojang's GuiGraphics to work correctly with them.
- OPENGL: Scissor settings that will be modified by other mods will be recorded and restored using OpenGL to work correctly with them even if they don't set viewport using Mojang's GuiGraphics, which is slower but has most compatibility.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- IGNORED: 禁用裁切区域还原, 更快, 但可能降低了对修改了裁切区域的MOD兼容性.
- MOJANG: 使用Mojang提供的GuiGraphics对可能被其他MOD修改的裁切区域进行记录和还原, 以改善兼容性.
- OPENGL: 使用OpenGL对可能被其他MOD修改的裁切区域进行记录和还原, 以在即使MOD不使用Mojang提供的GuiGraphics的情况下改善兼容性, 略慢但能保证最佳兼容性.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Configure
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 配置

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Block Buffer Restoring Settings
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 块缓冲还原配置

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
A few mods and shader packs will use their on block buffers when rendering, which may introduce conflicts when working with Accelerated Rendering that also uses block buffers.
Block Buffer Restoring can record the binding of block buffers before the acceleration and restore them after the acceleration to work correctly with them.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
部分MOD和光影会使用块缓冲进行渲染, 可能会与同样使用块缓冲的加速渲染造成冲突.
块缓冲还原可以在加速前记录块缓冲绑定, 在加速后还原成加速前的块缓冲绑定以实现更好的兼容性

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Enable Block Buffer Restoring
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 启用块缓冲还原

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- DISABLED: Disable block buffer restoring, which is faster but may cause visual glitches with mods and shaders that uses block buffers.
- ENABLED: Enable block buffer restoring, which may be slower due to recording and restoring block buffer bindings that ensures working correctly with mods and shaders that use block buffers.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁用块缓冲还原, 速度更快但可能与使用块缓冲的MOD和光影冲突.
- ENABLED: 启用块缓冲还原, 速度可能由于需要记录和还原块缓冲绑定而略慢, 但能确保在使用了块缓冲的MOD和光影的环境中正常工作.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Block Buffer Binding Cache Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 块缓冲绑定缓存类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- SIMPLE: The most basic implementation of cache. Usually used for testing if other cache types are working properly.
- HANDLE: Faster implementation of cache using VarHandle and flatten values to improve performance on read/write operations.
- UNSAFE: Fastest implementation of cache using unsafe memory operations that skip multiple safety checks to read/write.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- SIMPLE: 最基础的缓存实现, 通常用来检测其他缓存类型是否正常工作.
- HANDLE: 更快的缓存实现, 使用VarHandle和扁平化数据来提高读写性能.
- UNSAFE: 最快的缓存实现, 使用了不安全的内存操作来跳过多项检查进行读写.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Shader Storage Buffer Restoring Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 着色器储存缓冲还原类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- IGNORED: Shader storage buffers will not be restored which improves FPS but reduces compatibility with mods and shaders that ues shader storage buffers.
- RESTORED: Shader storage buffers will be restored, which is slight slower but has better compatibility with mods and shaders that ues shader storage buffers.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- IGNORED: 着色器储存缓冲的还原将被忽略, 可以改善FPS但可能降低与使用了着色器储存缓冲的MOD和光影的兼容性.
- RESTORED: 着色器储存缓冲将被记录和还原, 可能略微降低FPS但与使用了着色器储存缓冲的MOD和光影有更好的兼容性.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Atomic Counter Buffer Restoring Type
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 原子计数器缓冲还原类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
- IGNORED: Atomic counter buffers will not be restored which improves FPS but reduces compatibility with mods and shaders that ues atomic counter buffers.
- RESTORED: Atomic counter buffers will be restored, which is slight slower but has better compatibility with mods and shaders that ues atomic counter buffers.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
- IGNORED: 原子计数器缓冲的还原将被忽略, 可以改善FPS但可能降低与使用了原子计数器缓冲的MOD和光影的兼容性.
- RESTORED: 原子计数器缓冲将被记录和还原, 可能略微降低FPS但与使用了原子计数器缓冲的MOD和光影有更好的兼容性.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Shader Storage Buffer Restoring Range
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 着色器储存缓冲还原范围

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
Range of shader storage buffer bindings that will be restored.
Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less shader storage buffer restored but less compatibility, while larger values means more shader storage buffer restored and better compatibility. More shader storage buffers means less FPS.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
将要被记录和还原的着色器储存缓冲绑定点范围.
修改此项数值可能会影响FPS. 越高的值代表越大的着色器储存缓冲还原范围和更好的兼容性, 越小的值代表越少的着色器储存缓冲还原范围但更差的兼容性, 还原范围越大, 开销造成的FPS降低越大.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Atomic Counter Buffer Restoring Range
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 原子计数器缓冲还原范围

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en:
Range of atomic counter buffer bindings that will be restored.
Changing this value may affects your FPS. Smaller value means less atomic counter buffer restored but less compatibility, while larger values means more atomic counter buffer restored and better compatibility. More atomic counter buffers means less FPS.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh:
将要被记录和还原的原子计数器缓冲绑定点范围.
修改此项数值可能会影响FPS. 越高的值代表越大的原子计数器缓冲还原范围和更好的兼容性, 越小的值代表越少的原子计数器缓冲还原范围但更差的兼容性, 还原范围越大, 开销造成的FPS降低越大.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.en: Configure
acceleratedrendering.configuration.core_.zh: 配置

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en: Accelerated Entity Rendering uses GPU to cache and transform vertices whiling rendering entities, instead of generating and transforming vertices every time the entities are rendered in CPU.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh: 加速实体渲染使用GPU对ModelPart进行缓存和顶点变换, 而非原版在CPU每次渲染时重建和变换顶点.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Disable accelerated entity rendering.
- ENABLED: Enable accelerated entity rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁用加速实体渲染.
- ENABLED: 启用加速实体渲染.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- VANILLA: Entities will not be rendered into the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own entities.
- ACCELERATED: All entities will be rendered in the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own entities.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- VANILLA: 除非其他MOD在渲染其实体时显式声明临时开启加速渲染, 否则实体将不会通过加速管线渲染.
- ACCELERATED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其实体时时显式声明临时关闭加速渲染, 否则实体将始终通过加速管线渲染.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- CLIENT: Cached mesh will be stored on the client side (CPU), which will use less VRAM but take more time to upload to the server side (GPU) during rendering.
- SERVER: Cached mesh will be stored on the server side (GPU), which may speed up rendering but will use more VRAM to store the mesh.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- CLIENT: 模型将缓存在客户端(CPU)侧, 占用更少显存, 但渲染时可能会耗费额外时间上传至服务端侧(GPU).
- SERVER: 模型将缓存在服务端(GPU)侧, 获得更好的渲染性能, 但会占用更多显存.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not accelerate entities when rendering it in a GUI unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own entities.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will still accelerate entities when rendering it in a GUI unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own entities.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其实体时显式声明临时开启GUI实体加速, 实体将不会在GUI绘制中被加速渲染.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其实体时显式声明临时关闭GUI实体加速, 实体将始终会在GUI绘制中被加速渲染.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en: Accelerated Item Rendering uses GPU to cache and transform vertices while rendering item models, instead of generating and transforming vertices every time the item models are rendered in CPU.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh: 加速物品渲染使用GPU对物品模型进行缓存和顶点变换, 而非原版在CPU每次渲染时重建和变换顶点.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Disable accelerated item rendering.
- ENABLED: Enable accelerated item rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁用加速物品渲染.
- ENABLED: 启用加速物品渲染.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not bake mesh for quads provided by dynamic item models (something that is not SimpleBakedModel) unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will bake mesh for all quads provided by dynamic item models (something that is not SimpleBakedModel) unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own item models, which will accelerate the rendering of these models but will crash if they keep allocating new quad data. (but who will?)
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明开启动态面缓存, 否则加速渲染将不会为动态物品模型(不属于SimpleBakedModel的模型)提供的面进行模型缓存.
- ENABLED: 除非MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时关闭动态面缓存, 否则加速渲染将会为所有动态物品模型(不属于SimpleBakedModel的模型)提供的面进行模型缓存, 加速动态物品模型的渲染, 但如果动态物品模型一直分配新的面数据则有可能崩溃. (没人这么干, 就算这么干了, 那也是他们的错)

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- VANILLA: Item models will not be rendered into the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
- ACCELERATED: All item models will be rendered in the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- VANILLA: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时开启加速渲染, 否则物品模型将不会通过加速管线渲染.
- ACCELERATED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时时显式声明临时关闭加速渲染, 否则物品模型将始终通过加速管线渲染.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- CLIENT: Cached mesh will be stored on the client side (CPU), which will use less VRAM but take more time to upload to the server side (GPU) during rendering.
- SERVER: Cached mesh will be stored on the server side (GPU), which may speed up rendering but will use more VRAM to store the mesh.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- CLIENT: 模型将缓存在客户端(CPU)侧, 占用更少显存, 但渲染时可能会耗费额外时间上传至服务端侧(GPU).
- SERVER: 模型将缓存在服务端(GPU)侧, 获得更好的渲染性能, 但会占用更多显存.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not accelerate item models that are marked as "too small to make up the cost of acceleration" when rendering it in hand unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will still accelerate item models that are marked as "too small to make up the cost of acceleration" when rendering it in hand unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own item models, which may slightly reduce the FPS but accelerate vanilla-like modded item models with large amount of vertices.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时开启手中物品加速, 否则加速渲染将不会在渲染手中物品时加速那些被标记为"太过简单加速后无法弥补加速带来的开销"的模型.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时关闭手中物品加速, 否则加速渲染将仍然会在渲染手中物品时加速那些被标记为"太过简单加速后无法弥补加速带来的开销"的模型, 这可能会造成额外开销轻微降低FPS, 但是允许加速那些拥有大量顶点的类原版MOD物品模型.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not accelerate item models that are marked as "too small to make up the cost of acceleration" when rendering it in a container GUI unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own item models.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will still accelerate item models that are marked as "too small to make up the cost of acceleration" when rendering it in a container GUI unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own item models, which may slightly reduce the FPS but accelerate vanilla-like modded item models with large amount of vertices.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时开启GUI物品加速, 否则加速渲染将不会在渲染容器GUI时加速那些被标记为"太过简单加速后无法弥补加速带来的开销"的模型.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其物品模型时显式声明临时关闭GUI物品加速, 否则加速渲染将仍然会在渲染容器GUI时加速那些被标记为"太过简单加速后无法弥补加速带来的开销"的模型, 这可能会造成额外开销轻微降低FPS, 但是允许加速那些拥有大量顶点的类原版MOD物品模型.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Items in the container GUI will be rendered as per item per batch if the GUI Acceleration is enabled, which is inefficient and may cause reduction in FPS, but it has better compatibility in modded container GUI.
- ENABLED: Items in the container GUI will be rendered together in a single batch if the GUI Acceleration is enabled, which is much more efficient but has little compatibility in modded container GUI.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 当GUI物品加速开启时, 在容器GUI中被渲染的物品将以每渲染一次物品就执行一次绘制的方式进行渲染, 这样比较低效并对FPS造成较大影响, 但拥有更好的MOD兼容性.
- ENABLED: 当GUI物品加速开启时, 在容器GUI中被渲染的物品将会统一收集至一次合批中绘制, 这样极大提升了渲染效率但是对MOD的容器GUI兼容性较差.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Items rendered in background and slots will be separated into two batches when accelerate container GUI, which is inefficient any may cause slight reduction in FPS, but it has better compatibility in modded container GUI.
- ENABLED: Items rendered in background and slots will be merged into a single batch when accelerate container GUI, which is much more efficient but has less compatibility in modded container GUI.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 当GUI物品合批时, 背景和物品栏渲染的物品将独立分为两个批次进行绘制, 这样比较低效并对FPS有轻微影响, 但拥有更好的MOD兼容性.
- ENABLED: 当GUI物品合批时, 背景和物品栏渲染的物品将合并为一个单独的批次进行绘制, 这样提升了渲染效率但是对MOD的容器GUI兼容性较差.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en: Accelerated Text Rendering uses GPU to cache and transform vertices whiling rendering text through BakedGlyph, instead of generating and transforming vertices every time the text are rendered in CPU.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh: 加速文字渲染使用GPU对BakedGlyph进行缓存和顶点变换, 而非原版在CPU每次渲染时重建和变换顶点.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- DISABLED: Disable accelerated text rendering.
- ENABLED: Enable accelerated text rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁用加速文字渲染.
- ENABLED: 启用加速文字渲染.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- VANILLA: Text will not be rendered into the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own text.
- ACCELERATED: All text will be rendered in the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own text.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- VANILLA: 除非其他MOD在渲染其文字时显式声明临时开启加速渲染, 否则文字将不会通过加速管线渲染.
- ACCELERATED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其文字时时显式声明临时关闭加速渲染, 否则文字将始终通过加速管线渲染.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.en:
- CLIENT: Cached mesh will be stored on the client side (CPU), which will use less VRAM but take more time to upload to the server side (GPU) during rendering.
- SERVER: Cached mesh will be stored on the server side (GPU), which may speed up rendering but will use more VRAM to store the mesh.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.accel.zh:
- CLIENT: 模型将缓存在客户端(CPU)侧, 占用更少显存, 但渲染时可能会耗费额外时间上传至服务端侧(GPU).
- SERVER: 模型将缓存在服务端(GPU)侧, 获得更好的渲染性能, 但会占用更多显存.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.orien.en: Simple orientation face culling uses an compute shader before the draw call to discard faces that is not visible on screen by checking if it is facing to the screen using a determinant of 3 * 3 matrix.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.orien.zh: 简单朝向面剔除在绘制调用前使用一个根据3x3矩阵行列式来判断面是否朝向屏幕的ComputeShader(计算着色器)来剔除在屏幕上不可见的面, 减少需要绘制的面数.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.orien.en:
- DISABLED: Disable simple orientation face culling.
- ENABLED: Enable simple orientation face culling.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.orien.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁用简单朝向面剔除.
- ENABLED: 启用简单朝向面剔除.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.orien.en:
- DISABLED: Faces will not be culled unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own geometries.
- ENABLED: All faces will be culled unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own geometries.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.orien.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其模型时显式声明临时开启简单朝向面剔除, 否则面片将不会被剔除
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其模型时显式声明临时关闭简单朝向面剔除, 否则面片将始终被剔除.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.orien.en:
- DISABLED: Simple orientation face culling will not cull entities that are not declared as "cullable".
- ENABLED: Simple orientation face culling will cull all entities even if they are not declared as "cullable", which may cause slightly visual differences.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.orien.zh:
- DISABLED: 简单朝向面剔除将不会剔除被声明为不可剔除的实体
- ENABLED: 简单朝向面剔除将会对所有实体进行强制剔除, 即使其被声明为不可剔除, 可能会造成轻微渲染差异.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh: 过滤器配置

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en: Filters allows you to prevent specific entities/block entities/items from being accelerated when rendering for better compatibility.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh: 过滤器允许为了兼容性手动配置阻止部分实体/方块/物品在渲染时被加速
启用过滤器

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- DISABLED: Filters will be disabled and all entities, block entities and items will be accelerated when rendering.
- ENABLED: Filters will test if the entities, block entities and items should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- DISABLED: 过滤器将被禁用, 所有的实体/方块实体/物品都将在渲染时被加速.
- ENABLED: 过滤器将在渲染实体/方块实体/物品时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该实体/方块实体进行加速.
启用容器GUI过滤器

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- DISABLED: Menu filter will be disabled and geometries in all container GUI will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Menu filter will test if geometries in specific container GUI should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- DISABLED: 容器GUI过滤器将被禁用, 所有容器GUI中的模型都将被加速.
- ENABLED: 容器GUI过滤器将在渲染对容器GUI中的模型时时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该模型进行加速.
启用实体过滤器

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- DISABLED: Entity filter will be disabled and all entities will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Entity filter will test if the entities should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- DISABLED: 实体过滤器将被禁用, 所有的实体都将在渲染时被加速.
- ENABLED: 实体过滤器将在渲染实体时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该实体进行加速.
启用方块实体过滤器

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- DISABLED: Block entity filter will be disabled and all block entities will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Block entity filter will test if the block entities should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- DISABLED: 方块实体过滤器将被禁用, 所有的方块实体都将在渲染时被加速.
- ENABLED: 方块实体过滤器将在渲染实体时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该方块实体进行加速.
启用物品过滤器

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- DISABLED: Item filter will be disabled and all items will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Item filter will test if the items should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- DISABLED: 物品过滤器将被禁用, 所有的物品都将在渲染时被加速.
- ENABLED: 物品过滤器将在渲染实体时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该物品进行加速.
启用自定义渲染阶段过滤器

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- DISABLED: Custom rendering stage filter will be disabled and geometries in all custom rendering stages will be accelerated.
- ENABLED: Custom rendering stage filter will test if geometries in specific custom rendering stage should be accelerated when rendering based on the filter values and the filter type.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- DISABLED: 自定义渲染阶段过滤器将被禁用, 所有自定义渲染阶段中的模型都将被加速.
- ENABLED: 自定义渲染阶段过滤器将在渲染对应自定义渲染阶段中的模型时时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否为该模型进行加速.
容器GUI过滤器类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- BLACKLIST: Container GUIs that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Container GUIs that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- BLACKLIST: 不在容器GUI过滤器列表中的容器GUI将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在容器GUI过滤器列表中的容器GUI才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).
实体过滤器类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- BLACKLIST: Entities that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Entities that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- BLACKLIST: 不在实体过滤器列表中的实体类型将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在实体过滤器列表中的实体类型才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).
方块实体过滤器类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- BLACKLIST: Block entities that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Block entities that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- BLACKLIST: 不在方块实体过滤器列表中的方块实体类型将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在方块实体过滤器列表中的方块实体类型才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).
物品过滤器类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- BLACKLIST: Items that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Items that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
BLACKLIST: 不在物品过滤器列表中的物品将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在物品过滤器列表中的物品才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).
自定义渲染阶段过滤器类型

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
- BLACKLIST: Custom rendering stages that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
- WHITELIST: Custom rendering stages that are in the filter values can pass the filter and be accelerated when rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
- BLACKLIST: 不在自定义渲染阶段过滤器列表中的自定义渲染通道将通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在自定义渲染阶段过滤器列表中的自定义渲染阶段才能通过过滤器并在渲染时加速 (即白名单).
容器GUI过滤器列表

You can configure the menu filter by this list.
Menu filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if a container GUI can pass the filter.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:

容器GUI过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应容器GUI能否通过过滤器.
实体过滤器列表

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
You can configure the entity filter by this list.
Entity filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if an entity can pass the filter.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
你可以通过这个列表配置实体过滤器.
实体过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应实体能否通过过滤器.
方块实体过滤器列表

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
You can configure the block entity filter by this list.
Block entity filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if a block entity can pass the filter.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
你可以通过这个列表配置方块实体过滤器.
方块实体过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应方块实体能否通过过滤器.
物品过滤器列表

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
You can configure the item filter by this list.
Item filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if an item can pass the filter.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
你可以通过这个列表配置物品过滤器.
物品过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应物品能否通过过滤器.
自定义渲染阶段过滤器列表

acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.en:
You can configure the custom rendering stage filter by this list.
Custom rendering stage filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if a custom rendering stage can pass the filter.
It's not recommend to modify this list unless other mods adds their own custom rendering stages.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.filte.zh:
你可以通过这个列表配置自定义渲染阶段过滤器.
自定义渲染阶过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应自定义渲染阶能否通过过滤器.
除非其他MOD添加了新的自定义渲染阶段, 否则不推荐修改次列表.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.en: Iris Compatibility Settings allows Accelerated Rendering to work correctly with Iris.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.zh: Iris兼容性配置允许加速渲染在Iris环境下正常工作.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will be incompatible with Iris and cause visual glitches when working with Iris.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will use compute shaders that fits Iris's vertex formats, which make it compatible with Iris.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.zh:
- DISABLED: 加速渲染将与Iris不兼容, 并在与Iris一同工作时造成视觉错误.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将使用与Iris顶点格式匹配的兼容Shader用于在Iris环境中正常工作并兼容Iris.
启用朝向法线剔除兼容

acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.en:
- DISABLED: Simple orientation face culling will not work with Iris because the culling shader is for vanilla's vertex formats.
- ENABLED: Simple orientation face culling will use another culling shader that fits iris's vertex format, which make it compatible with Iris.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.zh:
- DISABLED: 在Iris环境下简单朝向面剔除将不可用, 因为其剔除Shader仅为原版顶点格式设计.
- ENABLED: 简单朝向面剔除将使用与Iris顶点格式匹配的兼容Shader用于在Iris环境中正常剔除.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.en:
- DISABLED: Entities will not be culled when they are rendered as shadows unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own shadows. Which reduce FPS due to redundant faces.
- ENABLED: Entities will be culled when they are rendered as shadows unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own shadows. Redundant faces will be culled and improve FPS, but it may cause incorrect shadows.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其阴影时显示声明启用阴影剔除, 否则当实体渲染阴影时, 多余的面将不会被剔除, 这可能导致由多余面造成的FPS下降.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其阴影时显示声明禁用阴影剔除, 否则当实体渲染阴影时, 多余的面将会被剔除以提升FPS, 但这可能会导致不正确的阴影渲染.
启用多边形额外数据计算

acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.en:
- DISABLED: Extra information in vertices provided by Iris will not be included or calculated in the accelerated pipeline unless mods explicitly enable it temporarily when rendering their own geometries, which may cause visual glitches or incorrect rendering.
- ENABLED: Extra information in vertices provided by Iris will be included and calculated in the accelerated pipeline by a compute shader unless mods explicitly disable it temporarily when rendering their own geometries.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.iris_.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其模型时显示声明启用额外数据计算, 否则加速渲染管线将不会计算或上传顶点中由Iris提供的额外信息, 可能会造成视觉错误或不正确的渲染结果.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其模型时显示声明禁用额外数据计算, 否则加速渲染管线将会使用ComputeShader(计算着色器)计算并上传顶点中由Iris提供的额外信息.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.en: Curios Compatibility Settings allows Accelerated Rendering to work correctly with Curios.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.zh: Curios兼容性配置允许加速渲染在Curios环境下正常工作.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerated Rendering will not interrupt the acceleration of the Curios layer on entities.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will interrupt the acceleration of Curios layer on entities to prevent some mods using extremely bad rendering code that breaks the caching of Accelerated Rendering.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.zh:
- DISABLED: 加速渲染将不会中断对于实体中Curios层的加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会终止实体中Curios层的加速防止部分MOD因为过于离谱的渲染代码导致损坏加速渲染的缓存机制.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.en:
- DISABLED: Curios layer will not be accelerated by default to prevent some mods using extremely bad rendering code that breaks the caching of Accelerated Rendering unless mods explicitly enable the acceleration when rendering their accessories or equipments.
- ENABLED: Curios layer will be accelerated by default unless mods explicitly enable the acceleration when rendering their accessories or equipments.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.zh:
- DISABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其饰品或装备时显式声明启用Curios层加速, 否则加速渲染将不会对Curios层进行加速, 以此确保加速渲染不会因为部分MOD过于离谱的渲染代码导致崩溃.
- ENABLED: 除非其他MOD在渲染其饰品或装备时显式声明关闭Curios层加速, 否则加速渲染将会默认开启Curios层加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.en:
- DISABLED: Curios item filter will be disabled and acceleration of the rendering of all curios accessories/equipments will be determined by the "layer acceleration" option.
- ENABLED: Curios item filter will test if the acceleration of the curios accessories/equipments should be prevented based on the filter values and the filter type.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.zh:
- DISABLED: Curios物品过滤器将被禁用, 所有Curios饰品或装备是否加速都由"启用Curios层加速" (Enable Curios Layer Acceleration) 这个选项控制.
- ENABLED: Curios物品过滤器将在渲染Curios饰品或装备时根据过滤器所配置的列表和过滤器类型判断是否阻止没通过过滤器的饰品或装备的加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.en:
- BLACKLIST: Curios items that are not in the filter values can pass the filter and not being prevented to be accelerated."
- WHITELIST: Curios items that are in the filter values can pass the filter and not being prevented to be accelerated."
acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.zh:
- BLACKLIST: 不在Curios物品过滤器列表中的Curios物品将通过过滤器 (即黑名单).
- WHITELIST: 只有在Curios物品过滤器列表中的Curios物品才能通过过滤器 (即白名单).

acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.en:
You can configure the curios item filter by this list.
Curios item filter will use this list and the filter type to determine if a curios item can pass the filter.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.curio.zh:
你可以通过这个列表配置Curios物品过滤器.
Curios物品过滤器将根据这个列表和过滤器类型来判断对应Curios物品能否通过过滤器.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en: Miscellaneous Mod Compatibility Settings allows Accelerated Rendering to prevent negative optimization on specific mods by controlling whether Accelerated Rendering should accelerate the rendering of the corresponding mod.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh: 杂项MOD兼容性配置允许加速渲染通过控制是否对对应MOD启用加速以在对应MOD的环境下避免对其造成负优化

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of all mods listed in the miscellaneous mods compatibility settings will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerated Rendering will determine if a mod should be accelerated by the acceleration feature configuration item of this mod listed below.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 下列所有MOD的加速特性都将被禁用.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将根据这个MOD的加速特性配置项来决定是否为这个MOD启用加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Fixes for rendering order of armor trims and render layers in Vanilla Minecraft will be disabled, which is faster but cause slight visual inconsistency when rendering those features.
- ENABLED: Fixes for rendering order of armor trims and render layers in Vanilla Minecraft will be enabled, which is slower but has consistent and correct rendering order when rendering those features.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对原版Minecraft的盔甲纹饰和RenderLayer渲染顺序进行修复, 性能更好但是会造成轻微渲染不一致性.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对原版Minecraft的盔甲纹饰和RenderLayer渲染顺序进行修复, 性能可能略差但能确保渲染时的正确和顺序一致性.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of ModelPart models of Vanilla Minecraft will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of ModelPart models of Vanilla Minecraft will be enabled.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对原版Minecraft的ModelPart模型进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对原版Minecraft的ModelPart模型进行加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of animated ModelPart variants in Entity Model Features will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of animated ModelPart variants in Entity Model Features will be enabled.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对EMF(Entity Model Feature)的动画ModelPart变体进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对EMF的动画ModelPart变体进行加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of models in GeckoLib will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of models in GeckoLib will be enabled.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对GeckoLib模型进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将对GeckoLib模型进行加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of GeckoLib variant models in Touhou Little Maid will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of GeckoLib variant models in Touhou Little Maid will be enabled.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对车万女仆的GeckoLib模型变体进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对车万女仆的GeckoLib模型变体进行加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of bedrock models in Simple Bedrock Model will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of bedrock models in Simple Bedrock Model will be enabled.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对SBM(简单基岩版模型, SimpleBedrockModel)的基岩版模型进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对SBM的基岩版模型进行加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of UI driven by FTB Library will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of UI driven by FTB Library will be enabled.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对FTB Library驱动的UI界面(如FTB Quests)进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对FTB Library驱动的UI界面进行加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of UI driven by Sophisticated Core will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of UI driven by Sophisticated Core will be enabled.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对精妙核心驱动的UI界面(如精妙存储)进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对精妙核心驱动的UI界面进行加速.

acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.en:
- DISABLED: Accelerations of text driven by ModernUI's modern text engine will be disabled.
- ENABLED: Accelerations of text driven by ModernUI's modern text engine will be enabled.
acceleratedrendering.configuration.mods_.zh:
- DISABLED: 禁止加速渲染对现代化UI的现代化文字引擎所驱动的文字渲染进行加速.
- ENABLED: 加速渲染将会对现代化UI的现代化文字引擎所驱动的文字渲染进行加速.

acceleratedrendering.component.not_avail.en: Accelerated Rendering is currently running in an unsupported environment. Accelerated Rendering will not take effect.
acceleratedrendering.component.not_avail.zh: 加速渲染正运行在不受支持的环境中, 加速渲染将不会生效.
